content: Sɑkɑri u Yosue yɑ̃ku kowo tɔnwero wɑ u yɔ̃ Yinni Gusunɔn ɡɔrɑdon
u yɔ̃ win nɔm ɡeuɔ u kɑ nùn tɑɑrɛ wɛ̃.
Mɑ Yinni Gusunɔn ɡɔrɑdo u Setɑm sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, Gusunɔ u nun ɡerusi wi, wi u Yerusɑlɛmu ɡɔsɑ. A ǹ yɛ̃ mɑ Yosue u sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe dɑ̃ɑ nɔɔ ɡe bɑ wunɑ dɔ̃ɔn di?
N deemɑ yɑ̃ɑ disinuɡinɑ Yosue u sebuɑ u kɑ yɔ̃ ɡɔrɑdo win wuswɑɑɔ.
Mɑ ɡɔrɑdo wi, u be bɑ yɔ̃ win wuswɑɑɔ sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, bu Yosuen yɑ̃ɑ disinuɡii ni wunɔ. Mɑ u Yosue sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, wee nɑ nun wunɛn torɑnu wunɑ. Mɑ nɑ nun tɔ̃ɔ bɑkɑ yɑ̃nu sebusiɑ.
U mɑɑ woodɑ wɛ̃ u nɛɛ, bu nùn dɑwɑni ye yɑ dɛɛre bɔkusio. Mɑ bɑ nùn ye bɔkusiɑ. Mɑ bɑ nùn yɑ̃nu sebusiɑ. Sɑɑ ye sɔɔ, ɡɔrɑdo wi, u yɔ̃ mi.
U Yosue ɡɑri yini sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ,
ɑmɛniwɑ wi, Gusunɔ wɔllu kɑ tem Yinni u ɡeruɑ. U nɛɛ,

content.text: ɑ̀ n sĩimɔ win swɛɛ sɔɔ,
mɑ ɑ win woodɑbɑ mɛm nɔɔwɑmmɛ,
wunɑ kɑɑ win sɑ̃ɑ yeru kɑ ten yɑɑrɑn sɔmburu kpɑrɑ.
U koo nun kowɑ be bɑ win sɔmburu mɔ̀n turo.

content: u koo win sɔm kowo nɑɑwɑ

content.text: wunɛ kɑ wunɛn tɔn be bɑ sɔ̃ wunɛn wuswɑɑɔ,
Tɔn be, bɑ ko n ɡinɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ yĩreru wi u sisin sɔ̃.
Domi Yinni Gusunɔ u koo win sɔm kowo ɡɔrimɑ wi u sɑ̃ɑ kpii pɔturɑ.
Wunɛ Yosuen wuswɑɑɔ, u kperu ɡɑru yiimɔ.
Win tiiwɑ u koo yore te sɔɔ.
Kpɑ u tem mɛn torɑnu wunɑ sɔ̃ɔ teeru.
Wi, Gusunɔ wɔllu kɑ tem Yinni u nɛɛ,
yen tɔ̃ɔ te, i ko i sokunɑ i nuku dobu ko bɔri yɛndun sɔ̃ bɛɛn dɑ̃ɑ ɡbɑɑnɔ.
